bugs.error_message: supervisor nudge-while-running test: expected [0] to deeply equal [0, 20000] after advanceTimersByTimeAsync
bugs.root_cause: Not a supervisor bug: a setTimeout(fn, 0) created inside a fake-timer callback (during a tick) is scheduled 1 ms later (fake-timers/Node clamp), so the follow-up run fired at 20001 and advance(0)/advance(1) to exactly 20000 never reached it
bugs.fix: Test advances 2 ms past the run end and asserts the follow-up within 1 ms, then measures the next slot from the actual follow-up time

bugs.error_message: Bash command hung until timeout: `rm file && python3 ...` waited on 'remove file?' prompt
bugs.root_cause: rm is aliased to rm -i in agent zsh (like cp -> cp -i), so the chained command blocked on an interactive prompt and nothing after it ran
bugs.fix: Use `command rm -f <file>`

bugs.error_message: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded in html-to-text convert() on ~50k nested <div>/<b> elements
bugs.root_cause: html-to-text 10 walks the DOM recursively with no depth limit by default; a 262144-byte hostile HTML body nests deep enough to overflow the stack, which would block that mail's chunk on every run
bugs.fix: pass limits: { maxDepth: HTML_MAX_DEPTH (200), ellipsis: '' } to convert(); test converts 52k nested divs

bugs.error_message: bridge-smoke: FAILED: log lacks 'socat exited; stopping Bridge' (the line was in fact logged)
bugs.root_cause: `docker logs <c> 2>&1 | grep -qF ...` under set -o pipefail: grep -q exits at the first match, docker logs then hits EPIPE writing the remaining line, the pipeline returns non-zero and the check fails intermittently
bugs.fix: capture the log into a variable (serve_log=$(docker logs ...)) and match with [[ $serve_log == *...* ]]; failure message now includes the log

bugs.root_cause: Async call without await — returned Promise instead of value
bugs.fix: Added await to async call

bugs.error_message: login connection to an EC-cert fake server failed with PinMismatchError although the pin matched the certificate
bugs.root_cause: peerSpkiSha256 hashed Node's PeerCertificate.pubkey, which is the DER SPKI only for RSA keys; for EC it is the bare curve point
bugs.fix: hash the SPKI exported from new X509Certificate(cert.raw); EC peer test added to imap-pin.test.ts

bugs.error_message: fake IMAP server never saw the capture handshake complete (upgraded false)
bugs.root_cause: capture destroyed the TLS socket right after secureConnect, dropping the TLS 1.3 client Finished
bugs.fix: end() the TLS session (Finished + close_notify, no IMAP data) with a 1 s destroy fallback

bugs.error_message: ImapFlow sends ID with client name/version in plaintext before STARTTLS when the server advertises ID
bugs.root_cause: ImapFlow startSession runs ID before upgradeToSTARTTLS; clientInfo defaults are always merged
bugs.fix: guardPlaintext wraps client.run: before TLS only CAPABILITY/STARTTLS pass, ID and LOGOUT are skipped, anything else rejects SIFT_TLS_REQUIRED; wire test with a Bridge-like greeting

bugs.root_cause: No early return/throw for edge case: !Number.isInteger(uid
bugs.fix: Added guard clause: if (!Number.isInteger(uid)

bugs.error_message: exact-64 part downloaded with maxBytes 64 reported truncated: true
bugs.root_cause: truncated computed from ImapFlow download meta.expectedSize, which is the whole message RFC822.SIZE; BODYSTRUCTURE sizes are encoded while maxBytes caps decoded bytes
bugs.fix: download with maxBytes+1, truncated = decoded length > maxBytes, cut on a UTF-8 boundary

bugs.error_message: listUids/searchSince returned [] when UID SEARCH failed
bugs.root_cause: ImapFlow search() returns false on a failed command; plan mapped false to [], which would make the removal diff mark every message vanished
bugs.fix: throw FolderSource.<method>: UID SEARCH failed in <folder>

bugs.root_cause: doveadm lists \\Recent for mail no session has seen

bugs.error_message: Math.max(...listed) / Math.min(...uids) over a folder's UIDs can throw RangeError on very large mailboxes

bugs.error_message: CLI backfill plan had no UIDVALIDITY: a Bridge rebuild between count and run would ingest different messages under the counted UIDs
bugs.root_cause: BackfillPlan interface carried only count/since/uids
bugs.fix: BackfillPlan.uidValidity; countBackfill/runBackfill examine and refuse (reason resyncing) on mismatch

bugs.error_message: Uncaught Exception: error: terminating connection due to administrator command (57P01) / Connection terminated unexpectedly, during lock.test.ts terminated-backend case
bugs.root_cause: pg-pool removes its idle 'error' listener while a client is checked out; a backend ended by the server while withIngestLock held the client emitted an unhandled 'error' event, and the dead client was released back to the pool (unlock threw before release)
bugs.fix: withIngestLock attaches its own client 'error' listener for the checkout, skips the unlock on a broken connection, releases with the error (pool discards it), and rethrows fn's error or else the connection/unlock error

bugs.error_message: bridge-init: account 1 state: locked; mailbox "personal": no Bridge account has its address; nothing written (no backup, no wrote SIFT_PERSONAL_IMAP_PASSWORD)

bugs.fix: waitUsersLoaded polls GetUserList every 1 s up to 120 s until no account is LOCKED; a still-loading account after the limit fails with a clear network message (exit 3). Go tests in main_test.go; commit 7fd1580

bugs.error_message: sift migrate: backup directory /backups is not writable; on Linux run: chown 1000 /backups (setup exit 1 during 02-19 `docker compose up -d --build worker`)
bugs.root_cause: On the macOS host ./backups is owned by uid 1000 (the Linux-only chown hint was applied on macOS). Docker Desktop presents a dir owned by a non-host uid as root-owned inside the container, so uid 1000 (node) cannot write the pre-migration dump. Host user 501 cannot rename or chown it without sudo.
bugs.fix: Owner ran `sudo chown "$(id -u)" backups` (host uid 501). Verified writable from the setup container; rerun `docker compose up -d --build worker` at 17:53Z wrote the pre-0007 backup and applied 0005-0007. (The "not writable" line still shown by `docker compose logs setup` is from the earlier failed run of the same container.)
